needsARealService: Notification templates: save a notification’s answers under a name, list and search them, delete one, and start a new notification from one. Plants-frontend and its backend have none.

operations.name: listTemplates

params.q: text to find in the name

operations.returns: { items: [template without fulfilment], page, pageSize, totalItems, totalPages }, newest first, for the organisation in the Trade-Imports-Organisation-Id header
errors: 400 when the page is out of range

operations.name: getTemplate
errors: 404 when the organisation has no such template

operations.name: createTemplate
operations.returns: the saved template, with its new id and createdAt
errors: 400 with a problem body, { errors: { name: [message] } }, when the name is empty

operations.name: deleteTemplate
errors: 404 when the organisation has no such template

fields.name: fulfilment
fields.type: object: the notification’s answers, as the fulfilments API stores them

body.name: My usual roses from the Netherlands

response.name: My usual roses from the Netherlands

openQuestions: Which answers should a template keep? Arrival dates and reference numbers probably should not carry over.
What happens to a template when the questions change and its answers no longer fit?
Can a template be shared across an organisation, or is it one person’s?
notes: CDP dev has no backend for this service, so index.js keeps isStubDataMode() to choose stub.js until a real service exists.
